resources.string: You can keep using CommaView. The download carries on, and the Update button at the top says Install when it\'s ready.
Allow CommaView to install apps (a one-time Android setting), then come back and tap Install.
The download is verified. Android asks you to confirm the install.
You already have the latest CommaView release.
Checking %1$s\'s saved beta access. Members can use CommaView offline while their access pass is valid.
CommaView is currently available to invited beta members. Sign in with the account that received your invitation to continue.
Confirm the email CommaView sent you to keep your place on the waitlist. An accepted beta invitation is required to use the app.
Your beta invitation is ready. Accept it from your email, then check access here to continue.
This account is on the waitlist. CommaView emails you when your beta invitation is ready. If you\'ve already accepted it, check access again.
Connect %1$s to the internet to renew your access pass, or sign in again. The comma\'s hotspot alone doesn\'t provide internet access.
Couldn\'t open sign-in. Check that a browser is installed and enabled, then try again.
This account still needs an accepted beta invitation.
Sign in with your invited account to continue.
Beta access is checked on %1$s. Your existing comma setup stays saved.
The update service didn\'t answer. Try again later.
